_comment: Copy this file to webapp_config.json (gitignored) or let the webapp create it on the first 'Save defaults' tap. All keys are optional — missing keys fall back to the defaults in src/webapp_config.py.
_comment_auth_token: Empty string = auth gate OFF (the default). Run scripts/gen_token.py to generate a strong token; the webapp will then require Authorization: Bearer <token> on every API call from non-loopback callers.
_comment_auth_password: Optional companion to auth_token: when set, a fresh device with no token shows a sign-in sheet; entering the password swaps it for the bearer token. Set it with `python -m src.password set`; the salted hash is stored in config/app_password.json, and this key is only the legacy plaintext fallback, checked while no hash is stored. Failed attempts are logged to webapp/auth.log.
_comment_projects_dir: Master folder whose direct child directories the Coding tab lists as launchable projects. Defaults to the parent of this repo (E:\automation\... by default).
_comment_projects_ignore: gitignore-style patterns: directory names under projects_dir to hide from the Coding tab. Matched case-insensitively against the bare folder name; * and ? globs are honoured (e.g. 'archive', '*-old'). VCS/build dirs (.git, .venv, node_modules, ...) are always skipped regardless.
_comment_coding_favorites: Project ids (scanner slugs of the folder name) starred as favorites in the Coding tab (issue #250). Favorites sort to the top of the project list, and the '★ Favorites' header toggle filters the list to only these. Managed by tapping the per-tile star — you don't normally hand-edit this. Stored here, like projects_ignore, so the feature needs no extra file.
_comment_coding_hidden_agents: Coding-row launch buttons to hide: agent ids from src/agents.py (only 'copilot' here) plus the pseudo-id 'github' for the repo-issues button.
_comment_apps_scan_root: Where the Apps tab scans recursively for launcher *.bat files. Defaults to the same parent as projects_dir.
_comment_mini_apps_root: Optional folder of small helper *.bat files. A scan lists each .bat directly inside it (not subfolders) in the Apps tab's Mini apps group, with autostart off until you switch it on. Empty (the default) hides the group.
_comment_fleet_config_dir: Folder with the Copilot hooks, chief helpers and chief skill. The chief runs in it, and the Board and owner checks read from it. Empty uses this repo's own copilot/ folder; a path wins, so a machine that held a fleet-config-lite path must repoint it (copilot/install.ps1 -Migrate offers to).
_comment_session_host_port: Loopback port the PTY session-host binds. Never network-reachable; the webapp proxies to it. Must differ from 'port'.
_comment_tailnet_allowlist: Extra IPs / CIDRs allowed to reach the interactive terminal endpoints, on top of loopback + the Tailscale CGNAT range 100.64.0.0/10. Leave empty unless you need LAN access.
_comment_terminal_allow_private_lan: true trusts every private address (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, link-local, IPv6 unique-local) for the terminal-grade routes, for a machine with no Tailscale whose phone joins over a trusted home or office Wi-Fi. The bearer token and passkey still apply; anything else on that network can reach the login. Off by default. Settings > Terminal has the switch; it changes only on the PC itself or over Tailscale.
_comment_screen_allow_private_lan: true also trusts those private addresses for the screen view (the whole desktop, terminals included). Takes effect only while terminal_allow_private_lan is true; the screen stays Tailscale-only otherwise. Off by default.
_comment_outbox_scratch_roots: Folders, besides a session's own, that an agent may send a file to the Chat pane from (issue #1530). %VAR% and ~ expand, Defaults to "%TEMP%/claude", Claude Code's scratch base (where its SendUserFile files live); a non-empty list here replaces it. Settings > Folders > Chat file folders edits it and checks each folder on save (issue #1748). A .zip, .gz, .tgz or .7z sent from any of these folders is shown as a download-only card (served as an attachment, never rendered).
_comment_documents: Settings > Documents: files the reading sheet may show, rendered live with Mermaid diagrams. Each entry is {id, title, repo, path}: id a short lowercase slug unique in the list, repo the folder name of a primary checkout under projects_dir (a -wt-N worktree is refused), path a relative .md path with forward slashes. Only listed files can be read, and the text is gated like the Life OS file reader: Tailscale-only, passkey-required. An entry that fails these checks is dropped with a warning in the log; an empty list hides the group.
_comment_claude_show_local_window: When true (default), launching a session from the phone also opens an interactive terminal window for it on the PC. It connects over loopback so input works from both the phone and the PC.
_comment_terminal_history_lines: Bounded scrollback for full-screen (ratatui) agent sessions (Codex, etc.) — how many lines of history the session-host retains and replays on a (re)connect (issue #435 follow-up). Settings-tab configurable. Default 10000 is evidence-based (see src/vt_snapshot.py); bounds are 200-50000.
_comment_webauthn: Passkey gate for the interactive terminal. webauthn_rp_id is the bare tailnet hostname (e.g. 'pc.tailnet.ts.net'); webauthn_origin is the full https origin the phone connects to (e.g. 'https://pc.tailnet.ts.net:8465'). Leave both empty to disable the passkey gate.
_comment_notifications: Jobs-tab failure notifications (issue #66). Set both pushover_api_token + pushover_user_key and flip notify_on_failure: true to start receiving a push per failed run. notify_failure_streak: N also fires when N consecutive failures stack up (0 = disabled). notify_failure_summary: true pipes the output tail through the local LLM hub (http://127.0.0.1:8000, claude-haiku-4-5) for a one-line root-cause line prepended to the push body.
_comment_jobs_coverage: Missed-fire coverage for scheduled jobs (issue #697). jobs_coverage_interval_minutes is how often the webapp re-scans every scheduled job for a missing/disabled \AppLauncher\ Task Scheduler entry or an elapsed slot that produced no run record; 0 disables the background tick (the Jobs-tab '⚠ not firing' badge still computes on poll). On by default because it pushes nothing on its own — alerts route through the opt-in notify_on_failure gate (Pushover). See docs/jobs-tab.md.
_comment_session_retention: Retention window for the per-session audit trail (issue #902): every webapp/sessions/<id>.log and <id>.transcript whose mtime is older than session_retention_days is deleted by the webapp's daily sweep (src/session_retention.py). Files of a live session are never removed, and a file whose age cannot be established is kept and logged. 0 keeps everything forever. Hand-edit only; not exposed in the Settings tab. Dry-run: python scripts/session_retention.py.
_comment_secrets: One gitignored place for job secret values (issues #73, #72). A job's webhook.secret and any Job.env value can be a literal string or a '$secret:<key>' reference resolved against this dict at fire time, so a rotated credential lives here instead of jobs.json. Example: {"gh_key": "whsec_..."} then a job sets webhook.secret to "$secret:gh_key", or env to {"API_KEY": "$secret:gh_key"}. The legacy 'webhook_secrets' key still loads. See docs/jobs-tab.md.
_comment_api_tokens: Scoped API bearer tokens (issue #72), minted/revoked from the Settings tab — don't hand-edit. Each record stores only a salted SHA-256 hash of the token plus its scope ('*' or {"jobs": [ids]}); a job-scoped token can only call POST /api/jobs/<id>/run for its allowed jobs, so it is safe to bake into a Stream Deck button URL. The legacy auth_token keeps working unchanged.
_comment_skills_dir: Folder that holds the four issue skills a lane runs: issue-add, issue-start, issue-yolo and issue-finish, each a folder with a SKILL.md. Set it on a machine whose issue skills live in a repo of its own; copilot/install.py then links those four into the agent's skills folder instead of Lite's bundled copies. Empty uses the skills bundled in the Copilot folder. Settings > Chief shows whether each one is found, and a lane start is refused while one is missing.
_comment_team_os_dir: Root of the team-os checkout the Team OS tab surfaces. Skills live at <team_os_dir>/.claude/skills (Copilot reads that folder too). Defaults to the sibling ../team-os; when the skills dir doesn't exist the tab shows disabled, the same way the Coding tab handles a missing projects_dir.
_comment_sessions_state_file: The sessions-state.json written by the session_state Copilot hook in copilot/hooks/: the Board reads it for each session's status (working / needs-you / ...). Defaults to ~/.copilot/app-launcher-lite-state/sessions-state.json. Absent, corrupt or stale degrades to unknown status, never an error.
_comment_gitlab: The Board's forge: gitlab_group is the GitLab group or user namespace (subgroups included) whose projects the Board's glab reads span; empty keeps the panel dormant with a Settings hint. gitlab_host targets a self-hosted instance through glab's GITLAB_HOST; empty means glab's default (gitlab.com). glab must be installed and signed in (glab auth login).
_comment_speech: Speech to text (Settings > Speech to text). speech_enabled shows the record button in every message box; off, none shows. speech_base_url is the base of any OpenAI-shaped speech server (audio goes to <base>/audio/transcriptions), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 for the local LLM hub. speech_model is sent as the model name when set; speech_api_key is sent as a bearer key when set and is never returned by the API.
_comment_prevent_lock: Settings > This PC > Prevent lock. On, the app moves the pointer 1 px every 15 s and holds a keep-awake request so the PC does not lock for being idle; off (the default), nothing runs.
_comment_speech_keep_recordings_hours: Hours each dictation take is kept on disk under webapp/recordings/ (gitignored), so a crashed page or a failed transcription can be replayed and transcribed again from Settings > Speech to text. 0 keeps none.
_comment_serve_over: How the phone reaches the webapp, applied at the next restart (Settings > Connections > Serve over). auto is HTTPS when webapp/certificates/ holds cert.pem + key.pem, otherwise HTTP. https serves HTTPS (HTTP until a certificate exists), http never uses TLS, both adds plain HTTP on serve_http_port beside HTTPS on the webapp port. A phone's browser only opens the microphone on an HTTPS page.
_comment_copilot_flags: GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot) launch settings, also set from Settings. copilot_models is the list of model ids the pickers offer: which ids an account may use depends on its plan, so edit it per install (Copilot falls back to its own pick and prints one line when an id is not available). copilot_model is the saved --model (empty or 'default' lets Copilot pick). copilot_autopilot adds --autopilot, copilot_context --context (empty omits it), copilot_effort --effort (sent only with an explicit model), copilot_skip_permissions --allow-all. copilot_remote_session (default true) turns on remote access for every Copilot session Lite launches, through the CLI user settings, not a flag. chief_model is the chief's Copilot model; chief_context and chief_effort are its --context and --effort (empty follows copilot_context and copilot_effort).
_comment_copilot_monthly_credits: The Code tab's Usage card: a fallback allowance in AI credits (300 is the published Pro and Business figure). The card takes the used credits and allowance from your Copilot plan as the Copilot CLI last cached it (%LOCALAPPDATA%/copilot/copilot-user-cache.json) and shows unknown, naming this value, when that cannot be read. Its footnote counts this machine's credits today from ~/.copilot/session-store.db.
_comment_terminal_timing_log: Diagnostics switch: log each terminal keystroke's stage timings (webapp received, forwarded, first output; the browser's key-to-paint for a keystroke slower than 100 ms) and any event-loop stall over 100 ms to webapp/slow-requests.log. Default false; read live, no restart.
_comment_request_budgets: Per-request-class time budgets, {class: [soft_s, hard_s]}, laid over the defaults: past soft a request is logged 'over budget' in webapp/slow-requests.log, past hard a 'budget breach'. Classes: transcript-tick, transcript-open, session-list, board, send, git-status, shell, jobs-list. Empty keeps every default; read live, no restart.
_comment_transcript_caches: Transcript read caches. transcript_page_cache_size is how many parsed pages of unchanged transcripts are kept (0 turns the cache off); transcript_tail_cache_mb is how many MB of unchanged session transcript tails the session list and the Board keep, so each transcript is read once per change (0 turns it off); transcript_resolve_miss_ttl_s is how many seconds a Copilot session whose log was not found answers not found before the session-state folder is scanned again.
_comment_performance: Settings > Performance speed limits, each also a Settings field with a hard range and a Light machine value (docs/performance.md). poll_*_s are refresh spacings in seconds; poll_pause_hidden stops every page poll on a hidden tab; pool_* are thread limits (pool_input delivers messages to sessions; pool_sends is every other route, 0 = pick from the CPU count); git_status_ttl_s is how long a git scan is served as it is; request_budget_scale multiplies every request budget. Read live, no restart.
